# Background

Original fixture prose for Latchkit's test suite. This feature spans two
repositories, declared here through the `applications` front matter, to
exercise the application-pointer warning — those names are only resolved
through the user's local `~/.tinyspec/config.yaml`, which this adapter
never reads.

# Proposal

Roll a shared setting out to both the web app and the API server at once.

# Implementation Plan

- [ ] A: Coordinate the rollout
  - [ ] A.1: Add the setting to the API server
  - [ ] A.2: Read the setting from the web app
